title: Custom Nucleic Acid Extraction and Bead Clean Up
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol automates the bead-based purification of nucleic acids from up to 96 cellular samples using a custom workflow. Links: * [Invitrogen DNA Binding Beads for MagMAX-96 DNA Multi-Sample Kit from ThermoFisher catalog number 4489112](https://www.thermofisher.com/order/catalog/product/4489112?SID=srch-srp-4489112#/4489112?SID=srch-srp-4489112) This protocol was developed to perform the following steps: Bead binding, two wash steps, allow beads to air dry, followed by elution and transfer of the eluate to a fresh PCR plate.
Bead drying- pause to let beads air dry.

steps.title: Add binding buffer
steps.instruction: Add binding buffer to each of up to 96 input samples in the wells of a deep‑well plate positioned on the Magnetic Module, mix the contents, engage the magnets, and transfer the supernatant to the liquid‑waste reservoir covering positions A3‑A12.

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Transfer 70 % ethanol from 50 mL tubes into the wells of the deep‑well plate on the Magnetic Module, mix, engage the magnets, and discard the supernatant into liquid‑waste tubes located at positions A3 and B3.

steps.title: Second ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the ethanol wash by transferring 70 % ethanol from 50 mL tubes into the wells of the deep‑well plate on the Magnetic Module, mix, engage the magnets, and discard the supernatant into the liquid‑waste reservoir covering positions A3‑A12.

steps.title: Air‑dry beads
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol to allow the magnetic beads to air‑dry until no visible liquid remains.

steps.title: Elute nucleic acids
steps.instruction: Add TE buffer to the beads in the deep‑well plate on the Magnetic Module, mix, engage the magnets, and transfer the eluate to the elution plate located in deck slot 1.
